text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Neo Universe! It's Neo 
Universe! Neo Universe!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Unfazed by the heavy track, what a run! 
Conquering the Japanese Derby!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"She has splendidly exacted her revenge 
for the Satsuki Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A rematch... It didn't work out for both 
of them. Still...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
This one race, at least... —The Derby is 
the one race I can't lose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt like Neo Universe briefly glanced 
my way. But—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't quite tell what she was trying 
to say from so far away.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Zenno... Rob Roy...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, Uni-san...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Today, Neo Universe wanted to 'connect.' 
Not just on the surface—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—The “bottom of a higher dimension.” On an 
even deeper stratum.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
You were able to "reach" that place. I 
wonder what Zenno Rob Roy thinks...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uni-san, to be honest... I feel so 
frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The frustration of not measuring up to 
Uni-san. The lingering thought that maybe 
I could have put up a better fight.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“Even so! Giving it our all in competition 
brought frustration, respect... I felt a 
genuine ‘connection’!”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No story can be woven alone...! We need 
comrades whom we can respect from the 
bottom of our hearts!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Finally being able to run together like 
this today... I truly felt it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"For my story, that companion is Uni-san! 
And I will strive forward so that I can 
become that kind of presence for Uni-san 
as well!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It's "warm," isn't it? And... so very 
kind...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
And yet... 'I'm sorry.' Please leave me 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Huh, just one person...? Ah, okay..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I was the one leaving her 
alone, though...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
From now on, we're together. I'll be 
following right behind you, no matter 
what!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feelings that connected, and secrets that 
couldn't. Though a few things passed by 
each other—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe had successfully completed 
her First Drive with Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—On the way home that day. Taking a little 
detour to cool down after the 
excitement...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, everything is going according to 
the "blueprint" so far.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, and then the Japanese 
Derby... Everything is going completely 
according to schedule.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Then for the next launch, we proceed 
according to the "blueprint"..."
choice_data_list: Yeah, on to the Kikuka Sho!
Yeah, on to the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that... Neo Universe's expression 
suddenly froze.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Negative. That is far off 'orbit'.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe wants to wish for it. For 
more 'connection.' Especially..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
An "exchange" with the "Umamusume of the 
previous cycle."
choice_data_list:
An Umamusume from the previous cycle... 
Don't tell me?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I vaguely understood what she meant. The 
previous cycle, in other words, the 
generation of Umamusume just above us...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What that means is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Ticket" acquired. Linking to another 
orbit. Next to appear is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —The Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"System-wise, it's possible. Starting in 
June, Classic-class Umamusume are allowed 
to enter mixed Senior-class races as 
well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering the G1 Takarazuka Kinen in late 
June is an option. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is quite a rare case for a leading 
Umamusume of the Classic Triple Crown to 
also enter the Takarazuka Kinen. That is 
because...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Two GⅠ races in about a month. On top of 
that, the Takarazuka Kinen is against 
top-tier Senior-class Umamusume, making 
the burden far too heavy.
choice_data_list: I don't want to push you too hard, but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you," Trainer. But Neo Universe 
will provide "enlightenment."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""Connections" are the true source of 
energy. With the Trainer, and with the 
other Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap said those words to me. And 
Zenno Rob Roy made me "FEEL" it deeply, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I will conquer the sea of stars. Having 
touched 'SETO', next is..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I want to deeply "communicate" with "that 
Umamusume." "WARG" alone isn't enough to 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume she wants to make "contact" 
with... It seems Neo Universe already has 
someone in mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It certainly isn't a conventional route. 
But if Neo Universe can see the flight 
path in her eyes, then...
choice_data_list: ...Shall we head to the Takarazuka Kinen?

...Shall we head out to the Takarazuka 
Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Shall we give everyone a surprise?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Affirmative. Then it is "decided."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"To the Takarazuka Kinen. A 
'rendezvous'... for just the two of us. 
Toward an unknown outer universe..."
